# OrignaGta - Detailed Codebase Map (Full)

## Frontend (Flutter/Dart)
Location: `/origna_gta`

### Core Modules
- `lib/core/schema/schema_constants.dart`: Global constants and enums.
- `lib/core/theme/`: App styling and theme configurations.
- `lib/features/`: Feature-based vertical slices (Auth, Checkout, Orders, Products, Search).
- `lib/models/generated/`: Pydantic-equivalent Dart models.
- `lib/providers/`: Global Riverpod providers.
- `lib/services/`: External integrations (Firebase, Stripe, Algolia).

### Conventions
- PascalCase for Widgets and Classes.
- camelCase for variables and methods.
- ViewModels handle all business logic.

## Backend (Python Cloud Functions)
Location: `/functions`

### Core Modules
- `functions/main.py`: Entry point for all Cloud Functions.
- `functions/schema_constants.py`: Python-side global constants.
- `functions/models/`: Pydantic models for request/response validation.
- `functions/handlers/`: Feature-specific logic (Orders, Payments, Products, Users).
- `functions/services/`: Clients for external services (Stripe, Algolia, Mailjet).
- `functions/utils/`: Shared helper functions.

### Conventions
- snake_case for functions and variables.
- PascalCase for Classes (Pydantic models).
- Strict typing with type hints.

## Database Schema (Firestore)
Location: `/docs/database_schema.json`

### Collections
- `users`: User profiles, settings, and addresses.
- `products`: Product listings (draft, active, archived).
- `orders`: Transactional records, status history, and shipping.
- `product_questions`: Q&A for products.
- `ratings`: User reviews and ratings.
- `fcm_tokens`: Push notification tokens per user.

## Infrastructure & DevOps
- `firebase.json`: Firebase configuration (Hosting, Functions, Firestore rules).
- `firestore.rules`: Security rules for Firestore.
- `storage.rules`: Security rules for Cloud Storage/R2.
- `.github/workflows/`: CI/CD pipelines for staging and production.

## Verification & Testing
- `e2e/`: Playwright scripts for cross-platform integration testing.
- `functions/tests/`: Pytest suite for backend logic.
- `origna_gta/test/`: Unit and widget tests for Flutter.

## AI Agentic Ecosystem (.claude/)
This codebase is "Agent-Native," meaning it contains explicit instructions for AI models to operate as senior engineers.

### Specialized Sub-Agents (.claude/agents/)
Agents are specialized personas with restricted scopes and deep expertise.
- `firebase-architect-agent.md`: NoSQL modeling, scalability, and security rules.
- `repomix-analyzer-agent.md`: Cross-stack drift and system-wide architectural audits.
- `security-auditor.md`: Vulnerability scanning and adversarial logic prediction.
- `performance-auditor.md`: N+1 query detection and widget rebuild optimization.
- `logic-auditor.md`: Magnus Carlsen-style logic verification for complex flows.

### Repeatable Skills (.claude/skills/)
Skills provide procedural guidance for common project tasks.
- `firebase-scalability/`: Best practices for 100M+ user Firestore architecture.
- `repomix-codebase-snapshot/`: Workflow for holistic system analysis.
- `adversarial-logic-architect/`: Framework for predicting and mitigating malicious behavior.
- `canadian-law-compliance/`: Rules for PIPEDA, Law 25, and CASL.
- `flutter-semantics-playwright/`: Guidance for testing Flutter Web accessibility.

### Persistent Memory
- `.claude/LEARNED.md`: Historical project knowledge and bug-fix patterns.
- `STATE.md`: Real-time project status and upcoming task plan.
